title: The constants K and λ in Ramanujan's identity (9.2.5) of the Lost Notebook, with a hexagonal lattice sum calculator
description: Andrews and Berndt (Ramanujan's Lost Notebook, Part IV, pp. 215–216) could not identify the constants K and λ in Ramanujan's identity (9.2.5). We show K = μ − ν and λ = μ + ν (sum over coprime μ, ν ≥ 1) for Re s > 2, prove it from the Andrews–Berndt form via the six-fold symmetry of the Eisenstein integers (orbit-partition lemma with full proof), and give an in-browser calculator for the resulting hexagonal lattice sum R(s). Version 1.1 adds a 4-page paper (theorem–lemma–proof format), the closed forms R(6k) = (−1)^k (c_k E_6(ρ)^k − 3)/3 for all k ≥ 1 (c_1 = 1, c_2 = 250/691, c_3 = 5500/43867, ...), randomized checks at 40 values of s in (2.1, 20) with tail-corrected lattice sums, and checks at complex s. Numerical agreement in the tested cases is 1e-12 to 1e-20 relative (empirical, not a rigorous error bound).
